JOHN MATHEW
Python Developer
Email: john@example.com   |   Phone: 9876543210   |   Kochi, Kerala, India   |   LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/johnmathew   |   GitHub: github.com/johnmathew
SUMMARY
Python developer with 2 years of experience designing, building, and maintaining web applications and backend services. Skilled in Django and Flask, with hands-on experience in REST API development, relational databases, and version control. Strong problem-solving ability with a track record of delivering reliable, well-tested code on schedule. Quick learner who enjoys working in collaborative, agile teams.
SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, SQL
Frameworks & Libraries: Django, Flask, REST Framework, Pandas, NumPy
Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, Linux, VS Code
Other: Object-Oriented Programming, Unit Testing (PyTest), Agile/Scrum, CI/CD basics
EXPERIENCE
Python Developer	2024 - 2026
ABC Technologies, Kochi, Kerala
Developed and maintained backend services for an internal inventory management system using Django and PostgreSQL, supporting over 200 daily active users.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs consumed by the company's web and mobile applications, reducing average response time by 20% through query optimization.
Collaborated with a team of 5 engineers in an Agile environment, participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and daily stand-ups.
Wrote unit and integration tests with PyTest, increasing overall code coverage from 55% to 85%.
Automated recurring data-cleaning and reporting tasks with Python scripts, saving approximately 6 hours of manual work per week.
Junior Software Engineer (Intern)	2023 - 2024
XYZ Softwares, Kochi, Kerala
Assisted in building a Flask-based web application for internal HR record management.
Fixed bugs and implemented minor features under the guidance of senior developers, gaining exposure to production codebases.
Documented API endpoints and internal processes to support onboarding of new team members.
PROJECTS
Expense Tracker Web App	2024
Built a full-stack expense tracking application using Django, SQLite, and Bootstrap, allowing users to log, categorize, and visualize monthly spending.
Implemented user authentication, CRUD operations, and downloadable PDF/CSV expense reports.
Movie Recommendation System	2023
Created a content-based movie recommendation engine in Python using Pandas and scikit-learn, trained on a public movie-ratings dataset.
Deployed a simple Flask front end to let users search titles and view top-5 similar movie recommendations.
EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science	2020 - 2024
Kerala University
Higher Secondary Education (Science)	2018 - 2020
Board of Higher Secondary Examinations, Kerala
CERTIFICATIONS
Python for Data Science - Coursera
Django Web Development - Udemy
SQL for Data Analysis - HackerRank (5-star)
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Languages: English, Malayalam, Hindi
Interests: Open-source contribution, competitive coding, chess
